changes: Assistant review fixes (a5b802f..adbc4e9): remote outcome capture requires Attention on and the person's opt-in; a degraded assistant.json is copied to assistant.recovered.json and never overwritten with a partial decode; an outcome without endedAt is rejected instead of being pruned; journal replay deduplicates and sorts by event time; overflow IDs are scoped per meeting

Background push-to-talk restored with a Carbon Option-Space hotkey that consumes the key, suppresses while a text field is focused, reports registration failures, and ends a hold after 30 seconds even without audio

Moments: only open meetings are resolved, with invitation, preset and unique-title fallbacks after a stale meeting ID; sayReply records a delivered utterance and clears speaking when the card closed during playback; all delivery actions guard in-flight speech
Headphone routing no longer classifies device names: it accepts the CoreAudio headphone source, rejects speakers, and otherwise requires the person to approve the device UID

Localization: Russian Settings path uses Ассистент; the People memory key exists in both languages; voice-cache recovery matches _GenericObjCError, __GenericObjCError and nilError tokens instead of a bare substring
Compile fixes on top of the review commits (2da1adb): explicit AssistantDataDocument CodingKeys, Combine import for AnyCancellable, explicit self in the VoxAsset rebuild closure
